agent.problem: The question is not self-contained. “Him” is meant to refer to the Rabshakeh, but he is never mentioned in the question, so the pronoun depends on an earlier card; the only person named in this question is Hezekiah.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out that the officials' clothes were torn rather than muddy or soaked. The blank asks for an unseen word from verse 22 rather than testing a meaning the baker can infer.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
